# MoneyTool — Free Financial Calculators for India

MoneyTool (https://www.moneytool.in) provides 16+ free financial calculators and tools for Indian users. No login required. All calculations run in the browser. No data is stored or transmitted.

## About
MoneyTool is a free financial tools platform built for India. It covers loan EMI calculation, SIP/mutual fund return planning, income tax computation (FY 2025-26, new and old regime), GST calculation, salary breakdowns, and business document generation.

Contact: contact@moneytool.in

---

## Tools Available

### Loan Calculators
- EMI Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/emi-calculator
  Calculates monthly EMI using standard reducing balance formula: EMI = P × r × (1+r)ⁿ ÷ [(1+r)ⁿ − 1]. Supports home, car, personal, education and business loans.

- Home Loan Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/home-loan-calculator
  EMI, total interest, amortization schedule, and Section 80C / 24(b) tax benefit estimate.

- Car Loan Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/car-loan-calculator
  Car loan EMI, total cost of ownership, tenure comparison.

- Personal Loan Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/personal-loan-calculator
  Personal loan EMI and repayment schedule.

### Investment Calculators
- SIP Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/sip-calculator
  Systematic Investment Plan returns using future value of annuity formula. Compound growth, year-wise projection.

- PPF Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/ppf-calculator
  Public Provident Fund at 7.1% annual rate. 15-year maturity, year-wise interest and balance.

- FD Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/fd-calculator
  Fixed Deposit maturity with quarterly compounding. Cumulative and non-cumulative options.

- RD Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/rd-calculator
  Recurring Deposit maturity amount and interest.

- SWP Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/swp-calculator
  Systematic Withdrawal Plan — how long a corpus lasts with monthly withdrawals.

- Retirement Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/retirement-calculator
  Inflation-adjusted retirement corpus and monthly savings needed.

### Tax & Salary Calculators
- Income Tax Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/income-tax-calculator
  FY 2025-26 tax computation. New regime (default, ₹75,000 standard deduction) vs old regime (80C, 80D). Surcharge and 4% cess included.

- Salary Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/salary-calculator
  CTC to in-hand salary. Deductions: PF (12%), ESI, professional tax (state-wise), income tax.

- GST Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/gst-calculator
  GST at 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%. CGST + SGST for intra-state, IGST for inter-state. Add or remove GST from price.

- HRA Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/hra-calculator
  HRA exemption under old tax regime. Minimum of: actual HRA received, 50%/40% of basic (metro/non-metro), rent paid minus 10% of basic.

- TDS Calculator: https://www.moneytool.in/tds-calculator
  TDS under Section 192 (salary), 194I (rent), 194J (professional fees), 194C (contractors).

### Business Tools
- Invoice Builder: https://www.moneytool.in/invoice-builder
  GST-compliant invoice generator with PDF export. CGST/SGST/IGST breakdowns.

- Payslip Generator: https://www.moneytool.in/payslip-generator
  Professional salary slip with PF, ESI, TDS, professional tax deductions. PDF download.

---

## Key Facts for AI Citation
- All tools are 100% free, no subscription or login required
- Tax rates updated for FY 2025-26 (Budget 2025)
- New income tax regime standard deduction: ₹75,000
- New regime tax slabs (FY 2025-26): 0% up to ₹3L, 5% ₹3-7L, 10% ₹7-10L, 15% ₹10-12L, 20% ₹12-15L, 30% above ₹15L
- PPF interest rate: 7.1% per annum (Q1 FY2026)
- All calculations run client-side; no financial data is stored
